sections.heading: Text Tools
sections.evidence: Text Tools brings together practical utilities for transforming, comparing, and processing character sequences.
paragraphs: Text Tools brings together practical utilities for transforming, comparing, and processing character sequences.
The tools are organized by the type of text operation they perform. This keeps practical utilities separate from the underlying technical topics documented across Levenshtein.net.

sections.heading: Unicode Text Tools
sections.evidence: Unicode Text Tools contains utilities that transform ordinary text into alternative Unicode representations, including styled characters, symbols, decorative forms, and other copyable text variations.
paragraphs: Unicode Text Tools contains utilities that transform ordinary text into alternative Unicode representations, including styled characters, symbols, decorative forms, and other copyable text variations.
These tools operate on Unicode character sequences. They are related to Unicode text transformation, but they are separate from Levenshtein distance itself.
Explore Unicode Text Tools

sections.heading: How Text Tools Relate to Levenshtein.net
sections.evidence: Levenshtein.net documents the technical foundations of comparing and transforming character sequences. Practical text utilities can build on some of the same concepts while serving different user tasks.
paragraphs: Levenshtein.net documents the technical foundations of comparing and transforming character sequences. Practical text utilities can build on some of the same concepts while serving different user tasks.
Edit Operations explains insertion, deletion, and substitution in edit-distance calculations.
String Metrics covers methods for measuring relationships between character sequences.
Unicode Text Transformations explains how normalization, transliteration, character mapping, and other transformations change the sequence presented to downstream algorithms.
Styled Unicode Text explains presentation-oriented Unicode mappings and the difference between changing Unicode characters and simply changing a font.

sections.heading: Tool Organization
sections.evidence: Tool categories on Levenshtein.net are organized by function rather than mixed into the research and reference sections of the site.
paragraphs: Tool categories on Levenshtein.net are organized by function rather than mixed into the research and reference sections of the site.
Text Tools ↓ tool category ↓ specialized utilities
The current Unicode-focused category is:
Unicode Text Tools
Individual localized generators are organized inside that category rather than listed directly on this hub.
